doc: A type of village building, as a config entry (config/house_types/): what makes the smithy a smithy. Its kind, footprints, walls and roof, colours, sign, smoke, moving feature, and which yard things and doodads it has. The pipeline's type parameter picks one by name; the native runtime compiles every entry in.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The type's name (cottage, smithy).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What it is to the village: a home, a store, or a workshop.

fields.name: footprint
fields.doc: Its usual lot shape (design/systems.md, Village houses): wide (a broad front, its ridge along the street), deep (a narrow front and a long lot, its gable to the street), round (a hex flower, a house standing in its garden), long (a burgage: a narrow front and a very long lot, the house at the back of a long yard), or broad (a shopfront: a very wide front on a shallow lot). The household picks the size.

fields.name: footprint_alt
fields.doc: Its other lot shape, for variety along a street.

fields.name: walls
fields.doc: What its walls are made of.

fields.name: wall_color
fields.doc: Walls: plaster between the timbers, or the planks, logs, stone, or brick.

fields.name: trim_color
fields.doc: Timbers, corner posts, window and door frames.

fields.name: base_color
fields.doc: The stone base and foundation.

fields.name: roof
fields.doc: What covers the roof (a basic house's is always thatch or planks).

fields.name: roof_color
fields.doc: The roof.

fields.name: roof_pitch
fields.doc: The roof's slope, degrees.

fields.name: wall_height
fields.doc: One storey's wall height, metres.

fields.name: stories
fields.doc: Storeys at premium (1 or 2; basic and deluxe have one).

fields.name: door_color
fields.doc: The door.

fields.name: shutter_color
fields.doc: Shutters and window boxes.

fields.name: accent
fields.doc: Awnings, banners, and the tent's cloth.

fields.name: sign
fields.doc: How it says what it is: none, a sign hanging from a bracket (swings in the wind), or a board over the door.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: The sign's symbol.

fields.name: sign_color
fields.doc: The sign's board.

fields.name: smoke
fields.doc: Chimney smoke: 0 none, 0.3 a hearth, 1 a forge's.

fields.name: glow
fields.doc: A forge's or oven's glow at the door or lean-to, flickering.

fields.name: feature
fields.doc: Its moving showpiece: a waterwheel, windmill sails, a weathervane, or a lean-to workshop (for the forge or the bench).

fields.name: awning
fields.doc: A cloth awning over the front (deluxe and up), rippling in the wind.

fields.name: porch
fields.doc: A porch with posts and a bench (deluxe and up).

fields.name: laundry
fields.doc: A laundry line in the yard, swaying in the wind.

fields.name: banners
fields.doc: Banners on the front at premium.

fields.name: garden
fields.doc: A vegetable patch, by season.

fields.name: fence
fields.doc: A fence around the yard at premium.

fields.name: barrels
fields.doc: Barrels.

fields.name: crates
fields.doc: Crates.

fields.name: sacks
fields.doc: Sacks of grain or flour.

fields.name: anvil
fields.doc: An anvil on a stump.

fields.name: woodpile
fields.doc: A woodpile (bigger in winter).

fields.name: cart
fields.doc: A hand cart.

fields.name: well
fields.doc: A well with a little roof.

fields.name: bench
fields.doc: A bench by the door.

fields.name: stall
fields.doc: A market stall with goods, in front.

fields.name: flowerpots
fields.doc: Pots by the door, flowering by season.

fields.name: beehives
fields.doc: Skep beehives.

fields.name: hay
fields.doc: Hay bales.

fields.name: trough
fields.doc: A water trough.

fields.name: cauldron
fields.doc: A cauldron on a fire (an alchemist's or a dyer's), steaming.

fields.name: lanterns
fields.doc: Lanterns by the door at premium.
